import trimesh, numpy as np
m=trimesh.load('exports/model.box.e1af9484.stl')
# dense point sampling inside the hinge_arm detail box
lo=np.array([12.5,55.5,22.8]); hi=np.array([17.5,56.5,23.9])
xs=np.linspace(lo[0],hi[0],41); ys=np.linspace(lo[1],hi[1],9); zs=np.linspace(lo[2],hi[2],10)
pts=np.stack(np.meshgrid(xs,ys,zs,indexing='ij'),-1).reshape(-1,3)
inside=m.contains(pts)
print('point-sampled material fraction:', round(float(inside.mean()),4), 'of', len(pts))
# distance from axis (56,20): is every box point within r_out=4 of the knuckle?
d=np.sqrt((pts[:,1]-56)**2+(pts[:,2]-20)**2)
print('max radial dist in box:', round(float(d.max()),3), '(bore 2.7, outer 4.0)')
